title: Interpretation and visualization techniques for deep learning models in medical imaging

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Interpretation and visualization techniques for deep learning models in medical imaging》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Deep learning (DL) approaches to medical image analysis tasks have recently become popular; however, they suffer from a lack of human interpretability critical for both increasing understanding of the methods' operation and enabling clinical translation.
